jobs.description:
Rich gastronomy of all sorts plus a dash of Swiss charm—that is what you will love as our chef de parti at Mövenpick in Amsterdam. Bring your ideas to the table on the dishes we serve and ensure excellent preparation and the tastiest courses in a hygienic working environment. Be limitlessRunning and standing are part of this profession and can happen at all times throughout the day. Whether it is lunch, dinner, or a banqueting event, you will ensure the right preparation, so when it gets busy, you and your team can get to work quickly and efficiently. In this way the best dishes on the menu are created. Do you have your own ideas for dishes? Great! Contribute them and think along on how we can improve our menu and continuously innovate. We are one team with one task, so if you notice that the inventory is dwindling or if you need other products, then ring the bell. Are other departments involved in the dinner or event? Then you will also ensure open and accessible lines of communication with them. There are no limits to your abilities. In addition, you will be:
• versatile. Lunch, dinner, snacks, or banqueting—no matter where we put you, you will ensure the best quality;
• responsible for hygiene. You will keep your own bench clean and help others if necessary;
• proficient in English. Because of our international roots, our working language is English.
Afternoons, evenings and weekends— all these shifts will come along.
Proud to presentMövenpick: the place to enjoy life. Inside, we create a space for our guests to enjoy by relaxing at the bar with a delicious cocktail or a creamy cappuccino. In our restaurants, you can discover the most delicious special dishes. Are you an experienced Electrical Engineer with a passion for sustainable energy and innovative power systems? Do you enjoy being involved from the concept phase through to project completion while contributing to the energy transition? If so, this opportunity could be the perfect fit for you. As an Electrical Engineer – Energy Solutions, you will translate customer requirements into smart, sustainable technical solutions. You will design electrical systems for a variety of applications, including distribution centers with limited grid capacity, energy-efficient commercial buildings, and battery energy storage systems. You will be involved throughout the entire project lifecycle, from technical preparation and engineering to quality assurance and final commissioning. Working closely with project management and commissioning teams, you will ensure that every system is designed, tested, and delivered to the highest standards. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A permanent position with a minimum of 32 hours per week. A competitive gross monthly salary ranging from €3,800 to €5,900, depending on your experience and qualifications. A company laptop, mobile phone, and company car (depending on the role and experience level). An annual performance or year-end bonus. 8% holiday allowance. 30 vacation days per year (based on full-time employment), with the option to purchase additional leave. Employment conditions in line with the Dutch Metal & Engineering collective labour agreement (CAO Metaal & Techniek). The opportunity to work on innovative and sustainable energy projects that make a real impact on the energy transition. Key Responsibilities Design and develop electrical systems and energy solutions. Create detailed electrical drawings, schematics, and technical documentation. Translate customer requirements into practical, future-proof engineering solutions. Prepare functional descriptions, operation manuals, and technical documentation. Provide technical support to project

management throughout the project lifecycle. Develop and configure PLC software, including programming controllers and integrating communication protocols such as Modbus TCP within Energy Management Systems (EMS). Prepare test procedures and documentation, including Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT). Ensure all designs comply with applicable regulations and industry standards, including NEN 3140 and IEC 62040. About You You are an analytical and solution-oriented Electrical Engineer who enjoys developing innovative energy solutions. You have strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and thrive in multidisciplinary project environments. You also bring: An MBO or Bachelor's degree (or equivalent working and thinking level) in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline. At least five years of relevant experience in electrical engineering. Experience creating electrical schematics and technical documentation. Experience with energy storage systems, renewable energy solutions, or similar applications is considered an advantage. Knowledge of communication protocols such as Modbus TCP and experience with Energy Management Systems (EMS) and/or SCADA systems. Experience with engineering software such as EPLAN, AutoCAD, or SEE Electrical. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Dutch is considered an advantage. Hier kom je te werken Our client is a leading engineering company specializing in reliable and sustainable energy solutions. They design, build, and maintain advanced power systems for critical infrastructure, including data centers, industrial facilities, commercial buildings, and energy storage applications. By combining innovative technologies with engineering expertise, they deliver intelligent energy solutions that support the transition to a more sustainable future.

As Quality Manager, you will be responsible for leading a team of approximately ten quality professionals, ranging from experienced specialists to ambitious junior engineers. technical discipline. Proven leadership experience within quality management in a high-tech manufacturing environment. Are you technically skilled and do you enjoy working on complex technical assemblies in a modern production environment? For an innovative high-tech company in the Tilburg region, we are looking for a Module Assembly Operator. In this role, you will work on high-quality modules where precision, craftsmanship, and quality are central within a technically advanced production environment where complex three-dimensional modules are assembled, welded, and tested according to strict quality standards.

As a Module Assembly Operator, you will be responsible for assembling and welding complex modules. You will work based on technical drawings and execute work orders according to planning. Your tasks include TIG welding components, including welding with orbital welding heads, and assembling parts into complete modules.

In addition, you will test, measure, and inspect the modules to ensure they meet all required quality and safety standards. You will operate machines, set them up, adjust them when necessary, and perform first-line maintenance to ensure the production process runs smoothly.

Besides the assembly and welding activities, you will carry out repair work and contribute to pilot projects and the development of new products. You will digitally register completed work orders in the system and support colleagues by sharing knowledge and providing instructions when needed.

Within this role, you are also expected to actively contribute ideas for improving processes and working methods. This is a technical and responsible position where technical insight, three-dimensional thinking, independence, and teamwork come together within a modern high-tech production environment.

- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings
- Strong spatial and technical 3D insight
- Good command of English
- Experience with metalworking
- Minimum MBO level 3 education in a technical field (preferably mechanical engineering or mechatronics)
